expressions.en: I will follow up on this.
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan susul mengenai perkara ini.
Saya memohon maaf atas kelewatan ini.

work.scenario: You need a colleague to send you the latest project report and confirm their availability for a team meeting next week.
key_phrases: Sila hantar laporan projek itu kepada saya.
Mohon pengesahan kehadiran anda untuk mesyuarat minggu hadapan.
Mari kita jadualkan mesyuarat pada hari Selasa.

life.scenario: You are organizing a group outing with friends. You need to confirm who can make it, apologize for a late reply to an earlier message, and promise to follow up on the venue booking.
key_phrases: Saya akan *follow up* pasal tempahan tempat nanti.

tech.scenario: You're troubleshooting a software issue with a support agent via chat. They explain a complex solution, and you need to confirm you understand and ask them to send the steps via email.
key_phrases: Boleh tak hantar langkah-langkah tu kat saya?
Saya akan susul mengenai perkara ini sekiranya ada masalah lagi.
